For Game participants

Review by a judge

A league judge will look at your work and record an audio review of about five minutes: what worked, what to improve and how — with technical details. Reviews are in Russian.

Reviews cannot be ordered right now: they are available while a Game is running and at least one round has published results.

What to review

We will send the payment link here. Best of all — the email you use for your league account: the review will appear there.

Terms

  1. The review is an audio recording of about 5 minutes by a league judge (Milena), in Russian. It is the expert's personal opinion and does not affect round results, rating or certificates.
  2. One work — 300 ₽: a work from a round with published results. All works of the Game — 700 ₽: all your works of this Game, after it ends.
  3. After you order, the organizer will send a payment link to your contact within one working day.
  4. The review will be ready within 3 days after payment (all works of the Game — after the Game results are published). Listen in your account, section “My reviews”; if you have not signed in yet, we will send you a sign-in link.
  5. If we miss the deadline, we refund in full on request. Once the review is delivered, payment is not refunded.
  6. Your name and contact are used only for this order.
How it works

1. You order here. 2. You get a payment link. 3. The judge records the review. 4. You listen in your account whenever you like, as often as you like.

Already have a review?

It is in your account, section “My reviews”.
